description: This pie chart illustrates the "Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)," displaying a total of three distinct categories. The largest segment, colored green with a speckled texture, is labeled "LOCAL" and accounts for 94.5% of the distribution. The second largest slice is red, labeled "LLM," representing 3.9%, followed by the smallest slice in blue, labeled "EDGE_P2P," which makes up 1.6%. The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, bold category labels are positioned just outside their respective segments, while the corresponding percentage values are displayed directly inside the slices, also in bold text. Visually, the two smaller slices ("LLM" and "EDGE_P2P") are slightly exploded or offset from the main "LOCAL" body. The segments appear to be arranged in descending order of size.
